quantitative_conclusions: Initial parent AbsRel .091283111278; raw best improves only .000165438 (under .2%), so anchor stays step0 and ten checks stop at1000 after minimum updates. All observations satisfy the1%-of-best band from step0. The stable step0 represents little change from an already trained parent, not zero total training.

Own1000 steps/8000 exposures/40 effective epochs, no AMP skips or failures. Own440.442120s; parent full2500steps1241.128131s; route3500steps1681.570251s. Own peak1720.458496MiB, route4019.692383MiB. Raw12 predictions rescored9 metrics/counts exactly;16 parent LoRA tensors unchanged both checkpoints.

Final-best image counts:AbsRel102 improve116 worsen;F1 136 improve76 worsen6 tie;band103 improve115 worsen. Predicted edges429388 to440706, matchedGT290767 to293426;zero-edge images3 to3. This is a modest average F1 recovery, not collapse.

Use complete group conclusions in S_n200_seed320114.json: Sbest versus actual Lbest only a small uncertain AbsRel gain, F1 worsens and band error improves; same-endpoint Sfinal versus Lfinal is a different comparison.

Three post-best evaluations retained: .091147,.091321,.091175; train loss declines .03572 to .03506 while validation fluctuates within a narrow plateau. No evidence here of sustained major deterioration.
